definitions.explanation: Japan and the West taken together, mostly as a first element in compounds about styles of food, dress, architecture and the like.

examples.japanese: {和洋|わよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are Japanese and Western dishes.

examples.japanese: {和洋|わよう}⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an inn with both Japanese- and Western-style rooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{和洋|わよう}さまざまな⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The confectionery floor of this department store has all kinds of Japanese and Western sweets.

notes:
{和|わ} (Japan) + ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (the West, from ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧). It rarely stands alone; it appears as the first element of compounds and in {和洋|わよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ 〜.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}→和洋折衷：17524_wayousecchuu⟧: a blend of Japanese and Western styles
- {和洋|わよう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: Japanese, Western and Chinese (of cuisine)
- {和洋|わよう}{菓子|がし}: Japanese and Western confectionery
- {和洋|わよう}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: rooms in Japanese and Western style
